LAWS §10 TEACHES (for LAWS P9): (1) a scratch-archive git apply under the repo tree is vacuous without GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES: every apply line prints it and its path count . (2) a rig build needs a .git marker or Tailwind scans the tree (243 KB vs 108 KB CSS): served CSS bytes printed beside the dist identity (FACE, RULE, TAPE's critic). (3) an occlusion/hole ledger keys held per control, per band, PER ENGINE, never the thinnest band; a control-anchored member never loses a band (HIDE plant); an entry is struck when its cure lands. (4) a denylist of named properties is never a class cure: admitted declarations on the chain, file+line keyed, words and glyphs included (TAPE, third pass). (5) an authored reference is PINNED, never read from the subject's sheet; ruling 7's roster scope gets a gate (RULE N5). (6) a 'names something' test evaluates (Boolean(1)). (7) a gate keys the element that sets the painted size. (8) a ±ε verdict holds under two statistics or declares one. (9) a stamp hashes the EMITTED dist; a throwing reader is RED, never 'missing' (s10 seam 2). (10) ring rows read past a colour tween.
